name: XGBoost
when_to_use: Categorical or continuous dependent variable; large data volumes, tolerates nonlinearity and interaction between variables; requires tuning (grid/cv).

expected_input.question: How to improve prediction by sequentially fitting residuals?

plain_explanation.purpose: Makes very accurate predictions by combining small trees that correct each other in sequence.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When accuracy matters more than explanation and there is plenty of tabular data.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with response and factors, hundreds of rows or more.
plain_explanation.example: Predict the sale probability of each opportunity to order the contact queue.
plain_explanation.diagram: tree 1 + tree 2 + ... + tree N = final prediction
